description_en:
Queries columns of a Dataphin table in the asset inventory. Supported table types: dimension logical table, fact logical table, aggregate logical table, tag logical table, logical table view, physical table, physical view, and materialized view.
Release version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
查询资产清单中Dataphin表的字段，支持表类型：维度逻辑表、事实逻辑表、汇总逻辑表、标签逻辑表、逻辑表视图、物理表、物理视图、物化视图表。
上线版本：v5.4.2
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public get-table-columns --op-tenant-id 30001011 --catalog LD_test01_dev --table-name t_test01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTableColumns

parameters.help_en: Asset table catalog: name of the business unit or project space
parameters.help_zh: 资产表catalog: 业务板块或项目空间的名称
parameters.name: catalog
